name: IC Sensor — I2C, SPI — QFN
description: Surface-mount sensor IC cluster providing I2C and SPI interface support in QFN packages including 16-pin and 24-pin footprint options.
selection_hints: Select based on required communication interface, either I2C or SPI.
Match board layout to specific package footprint (QFN-16 3x3mm, QFN-24 3x3mm, or QFN-24 4x4mm).
Check required lead pitch of 0.4mm or 0.5mm against manufacturing rules.
avoid_when: The design requires through-hole or non-QFN package types.
Interfaces other than I2C or SPI are required.
PCB fabrication processes cannot support 0.4mm or 0.5mm pitch QFN SMD patterns.
